title: SQL Curator — Source-to-Target Map (STM)
description: Shape of the fenced ```stm JSON block. Field names here are the exact keys the bridge parser reads in output-parsers.js extractStm(). Changing a name here is an interface change and must be made in lockstep with the parser and the skill references.

sourceType.description: BigQuery source type, e.g. STRING / INT64

targetColumn.description: Output column; must match the SELECT-list AS alias exactly

transformation.description: Expression or derivation producing the target column

businessRule.description: Business rule, filter, join, or aggregation meaning
